name: secret-shield
description: Swaps passwords, keys and database URLs in your messages for named placeholders before Claude sees them and stores the values outside your projects. Showing a value on hover is opt-in.

revealOnHover.title: Reveal secrets on hover
revealOnHover.description: Show a hidden secret's real value when you hover its placeholder in the expanded view (ctrl+o). Off keeps values out of the screen entirely.

autoScrub.title: Scrub old transcripts at every start
autoScrub.description: Rewrite finished transcripts, memory notes and remember logs on every session start, replacing known secrets with placeholders. Off: they are only scrubbed when you run /scrub-secrets.

keepBackups.title: Keep unredacted backups
keepBackups.description: Before rewriting a file, save its original (with the secrets in it) to ~/.claude/secret-shield/backups/. Off: files are rewritten in place through a temp file, with no copy left behind.
